configure_mask_rcnn_model: configure a MaskRCNN detector with ResNet-50 backbone and FPN neck using mmdetection
set_rpn_head_params: set RPN head anchor generator scales, ratios, and strides for object proposal generation
configure_roi_head: configure StandardRoIHead with Shared2FCBBoxHead and FCNMaskHead for 80 COCO classes
set_train_cfg: set training config for RPN and RCNN assigners, samplers, and mask size parameters
set_test_cfg: set test config for RPN NMS thresholds and RCNN score threshold and mask binary threshold
